data.one_liner: Command line tool to measure test quality using mutation testing.
data.what_it_does: It mutates your source code and checks whether your test suite detects the changes. By modifying code and verifying test failures, it helps you identify poorly asserted or missing tests.
use_when: You want to measure the true effectiveness of your test suite beyond simple code coverage
You want to run mutation testing locally or in a CI pipeline using configurable XML rules
avoid_when: Your project has a very large codebase and you cannot afford the time required to run extensive mutation passes
You are looking for a standard assertion or mocking framework rather than test quality metrics
strengths: Fully configurable mutation rules and exclusions via XML documents and regular expressions
Supports incremental analysis in CI and optional lcov coverage integration to speed up runs
Generates multiple output report formats including HTML and xunit/junit
weaknesses: Running a full project analysis can take a long time (hours depending on code size)
Mutation testing inherently requires executing test suites repeatedly, which is computationally expensive
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev dependency via 'dart pub add --dev mutation_test' and run with 'dart run mutation_test'.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub add --dev mutation_test
dart run mutation_test
